item.title: Bryan Adams’ ‘(Everything I Do) I Do It For You’ Music Video Passes 1 Billion Views on YouTube
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard. Today, we're celebrating a major milestone for Canadian singer-songwriter Bryan Adams. His iconic ballad, "(Everything I Do) I Do It For You", has just joined YouTube's Billion Views Club.
[Soft music transitions]
Host: Released in 1991, this song was a game-changer for Adams, staying at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 for seven weeks and becoming one of his four titles to hit the top spot. But that's not all - it also enjoyed an unprecedented 16-week reign at number one on the Official U.K. Singles Chart, a record that still stands today.
[Music transitions to a short clip of the song]
Host: This power ballad was featured in the 1991 film Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves, starring Kevin Costner, which was a box office success, grossing over $390 million. The song was written by Adams, Robert "Mutt" Lange, and Michael Kamen, and its official video was directed by Andy Morahan.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: This isn't Adams' first time in the Billion Views Club - he previously entered with his 1993 ballad "Please Forgive Me". We congratulate Bryan Adams on this achievement and invite you to take a look at the official video for "(Everything I Do) I Do It For You", which can be found below.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. Join us next time for more music news and updates.
